notes.title: Jester: A Foolish Ritual DEMO NOW OUT!
notes.notes:
[p]Hey there everyone!!

It's finally time to [b]release our demo[/b] and let you all in on the fun! 
[i](Yes I know the announcement is for 'betas', but Steam had no 'demo' announcement)[/i] [/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="ABvznKBOnTc;full"][/previewyoutube][p]

We have been working on this demo for a long time, so we hope you enjoy it! While we kept some mechanics and features locked away for the full game, we want you to still enjoy this version as much as possible! 

So grab a friend (or 3) and play away! Can you escape the castle? Let us know in [url="https://discord.gg/feVPh8Yeed"]our Discord server[/url]!!

If you encounter any bugs or problems, that is also the place to let us know!

[b]What to expect in this demo:[/b]
[/p][list][*][p] Small demo level[/p][/*][*][p] Proximity chat[/p][/*][*][p] Jester reacts to sound [/p][/*][*][p] Jackboxes[/p][/*][*][p] 3 different potions[/p][/*][*][p] All player mechanics
[/p][/*][/list][p][b]What's not here, but will be in the full game:[/b]
[/p][list][*][p] Big separate map[/p][/*][*][p] More unique potions[/p][/*][*][p] Difficulty modes[/p][/*][*][p] Puzzles[/p][/*][*][p] Exorcise ritual[/p][/*][*][p] Achievements[/p][/*][*][p] Feedback from you!
[/p][/*][/list][p]So join our [url="https://discord.gg/feVPh8Yeed"]Discord [/url]server and give us feedback! We want to make this experience better for you!  [/p][p]
We also have some [b]stretch goals[/b] on which we want to work. Let us know which ones you would like to see the most! [i](These are not promised for our full release and may follow later)[/i][/p][list][*][p] Map events[/p][/*][*][p] Traps[/p][/*][*][p] More potions[/p][/*][*][p] Meta progression[/p][/*][*][p] And much more...![/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: We have a publisher!
notes.notes:
[p][b]Hey everyone,[/b][/p][p]We’ve got a thrilling update straight from the haunted halls of our cursed castle.[/p][p]First off, we’re [i]incredibly excited[/i] to announce that we’ve partnered with [b]Nexting[/b], a respected Japanese publisher, to help bring our co-op horror experience to players in Japan. Their team has deep roots in the horror genre and a strong connection to the Japanese gaming community—and with their support, we’re making sure the game truly resonates for fans in that region.[/p][p]This is a huge milestone for us, and we can’t wait for players across the world to descend into the shadows of our twisted castle… together.

[b]New here?[/b][/p][p]In case you’re just joining us: our game is a 1–4 player co-op horror set in a cursed, decaying castle. Trapped inside its halls is something far worse than ghosts—[b]the Jester[/b], a cunning and unpredictable enemy that toys with players before tearing them apart. He doesn’t just want you dead—he wants you scared, confused, and broken.[/p][p]Cooperation will be your only hope. But even that may not be enough.

[b]More Dev News Coming Soon[/b][/p][p]We know many of you are hungry for more dev updates—features, gameplay sneak peeks, mechanics, and more. We [i]do[/i] have a lot cooking behind the scenes, but we’re going to hold off just a little longer to make sure everything is polished and ready to show.[/p][p]Stay tuned. The castle is waking up.[/p][p][b]Wishlist if you haven't already!![/b] 

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3607770/Jester_A_Foolish_Ritual/"][/dynamiclink]Thanks for being with us on this journey. And as always: [i]don’t trust the laughter.
[/i][/p][p]~ Fire Foot Studios[/p]

notes.title: Dev updates!! #1
notes.notes:
[h3]Time for our first update!![/h3][p]Hey everyone![/p][p]Time for our very first update — and we’re excited to finally share some behind-the-scenes progress with you all! From now on, we’ll be posting more regularly to keep you in the loop with what’s cooking over at the Fire Foot offices.[/p][p]Please keep in mind: everything you see here is still a work-in-progress and might change by the time we launch![/p][p][/p][h3]Map Design / Layout[/h3][p]Level design is a huge part of what makes our game tick, and we've been pouring a lot of time into building a map that’s not just functional — but also fun and full of variety.[/p][p]Think creepy corridors, mysterious rooms, and hidden nooks waiting to be explored. Here's a little peek at some of the areas we've been crafting![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45582883/7fcb052bb16ff02e8e7c5aa321138392c8b807e7.gif"][/img][/p][h3]Puzzles[/h3][p]To shake up the core gameplay, we’ve been experimenting with light puzzle mechanics — adding a fresh twist without slowing things down.[/p][p]Right now, they're still floating in a gloomy gray box world, but eventually, you'll find them cleverly tucked away inside the cursed castle...[/p][p][/p][p][b]A stepping sequence puzzle![/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45582883/29870f4e274b74f6192fcaa2bf96b3e873efb9e6.gif"][/img][/p][p][b]A 'put these glowing stone objects in the right order' puzzle![/b] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45582883/69d725054bc93b1d269f965189bcf2b245bf7690.png"][/img][/p][h3]Skill games[/h3][p]We call them "skill games," but you can think of them as fast-paced, mini lockpicking challenges. These little trials keep things tense and test your reflexes in short bursts.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Quick time event - [/b]Nail the timing to unlock![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45582883/a0c14dbe2dc3ed592f28c7d45501d2491880a28f.gif"][/img][/p][p][b]Follow the zone [/b]- Stay in the sweet spot![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45582883/c59784e486610390ea54672c910f71f5bebf64fa.gif"][/img][/p][p][b]Right order[/b] - Hit the correct sequence to succeed![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45582883/9efe6a7184d5b277447425536e49d4997566749d.png"][/img][/p][h3]Lobby chat & Steam setup[/h3][p]We've also been making progress on multiplayer features! That means:[/p][list][*][p]Inviting Steam friends easily[/p][/*][*][p]Chatting with them in the lobby[/p][/*][*][p]Getting into matches together - fast and smooth[/p][/*][/list][p]We're aiming to make playing with friends feel effortless.

Thanks for reading - and thanks for being here with us at the beginning of this journey. We can’t wait to show you more soon. If you have any questions or ideas, drop them in the comments - we’d love to hear from you![/p][p]- Team Fire Foot [/p]

notes.title: First month on Steam!
notes.notes:
Hi there everyone!

Jester: A Foolish Ritual has officially been live on Steam for [b]one month now[/b], and we are so happy with the response! Thank you to everyone for wishlisting and following our progress. We are working hard to make this a fun experience for everyone!

We would love to [b]share more of our development[/b] with all of you interested players! [b]Listening to your feedback[/b], [b]playtesting[/b] early versions of the game... If that sounds interesting, be sure to join our [b][url=https://discord.gg/feVPh8Yeed]Discord server[/url]![/b]

Did you click on the link and see "Join Kick'n Hell's Discord server!"? That’s right — don’t worry, it’s not the wrong link. This is the server from our previous game, but we will update it in the future to provide information about our games separately.

Once again, thank you to everyone for showing interest in our game! If you haven’t [b]wishlisted[/b] or[b] followed[/b] us yet, please consider doing so — it really helps us out enormously!

- Team Fire Foot
